§6Machine type: §aAssembly Line / Component Assembly Line / Assembler / Precise Assembler§r

In the midst of this sea and endless solitude there appears a dim road, a road without human footprints.
No man has ever passed this place; no ship has ever sailed here.
Made everything in its where should be.
Glass tier limit energy hatch, laser hatch need UV glass.
Component Casing tier limit recipe can process. Casing tier require at least the recipe voltage level -1.
If Component Casing tier is higher than recipe voltage, enable Perfect Overclock.
UMV+ glass and Component Casing allow Wireless mode by placing no energy hatch.
Progressing time is fixed in Wireless mode.
Watch out your Global energy storage if use wireless mode, you should not want to see the power drain's landscape.

[note]Hatches[/note]: Input Bus, Input Hatch, Output Bus, Energy Hatch
[note]Structure[/note]: Tiered glass (limits the energy hatch tier); Component Assembly Line Casings (tier limits recipes); the casings in the optional task.
Use a Hologram Projector (or the NEI structure preview) to see and auto-build the structure.
